mentions.name: Codose
mentions.description: A web tool where users paste a link to an Exercism or LeetCode problem and it spins up a code editor with an AI tutor that walks through the solution step by step, offering mini lessons along the way when needed. Built with LLMs to make learning easier; currently on the Google AI Studio free tier and can be tried without signing up.
